TutorialCircuit.strDescription: A small oval shaped circuit. Finish 2 full laps, by crossing the start/finish waypoint to complete the race. Make sure to bring enough fuel if you use RCS thrusters!

TutorialOrientation.strDescription: Waypoints can be passed in any order that you want. It's up to you to find the quickest route. Finish the race by crossing the start/finish waypoint

TutorialPointToPoint.strDescription: A small U shaped point to point track. Reach the last waypoint to finish the track

Cue.strDescription: A twisty track with tight corners at a low orbit

RisingStar.strDescription: A dangerously low orbiting track that will lead you into the high pressure abyss of the lower Venus atmosphere

ORing.strDescription: A tiny ring that requires precision
